windows_11.label: Windows 11
recommended_telemetry: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent EDR
windows_11.notes: Some LocalAccounts cmdlets are unavailable in 32-bit PowerShell on a 64-bit host. Domain-account response belongs in an identity platform, not local-user cmdlets.

windows_server.label: Windows Server
recommended_telemetry: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent EDR
windows_server.notes: Containment must account for server role, clustering, load balancing, service identities, remote management, and business continuity. Domain-controller response requires a dedicated identity incident procedure.

linux_mint.label: Linux Mint
linux_mint.notes: Mint is Ubuntu/Debian-derived, but desktop services and installed firewall tooling vary. Detect nftables/UFW availability before proposing changes.

ubuntu.label: Ubuntu
ubuntu.notes: Server and desktop roles differ. Service, firewall, and account controls require dependency and remote-access checks before execution.

ubuntu_server.label: Ubuntu Server
ubuntu_server.notes: Before process, account, firewall, or service containment, identify server role, SSH access path, systemd dependencies, failover, active transactions, and recovery ownership.
